headline: Coca-Cola Stock Keeps Pace With The Market Without Following It
summary: The five-day run is not the story; the story is how little of Coke's long-run return has actually come from the market you already own.

headline: Divided Tech, Divided Fed: Navigating AI Capex Scrutiny And Mixed Macro Signals
summary: Big Tech's earnings reports laid bare a growing divide in the market's appetite for AI spending. Investors now focus on results from industrials, health care, consumer staples/discretionary.
